What happens when your dream home is a luxury cruise ship — and the company suddenly tells you to leave?
In 2023, Villa Vie Residences purchased and transformed an ageing cruise ship into MV Villa Vie Odyssey, a floating residential community promising a life of luxury and global travel.
Residents invested thousands of dollars, with some spending their life savings and even selling their homes to live aboard. The ambitious 3.5-year world cruise promised visits to more than 147 countries and hundreds of ports.
But in October 2026, the dream came crashing down in Cambodia.
